lithium.name: Lithium Ore
lithium.subtitle: Spodumene & Lepidolite

applications: EV battery cathode precursor & lithium chemical refining
Technical ceramics and heat-resistant borosilicate glass
Industrial lubricants and specialty metallurgical fluxes

gold.name: Gold Ore & Alluvial Concentrates
gold.subtitle: Assayed Precious Metal Feedstock
gold.moq: 1 Metric Ton · Subject to Lot Assay

gold.complianceNote: Strictly transacted under verified Nigerian mining title, chain-of-custody logs, and certified independent fire assay reports.
packagingOptions: Verified Sample Splitting for Independent Fire Assay
applications: Licensed metallurgical gold refining and bullion recovery
Gravity and hydrometallurgical processing plants
Institutional precious-metal reserve supply chains

tin.name: Tin Ore
tin.subtitle: Cassiterite Concentrate (SnO₂)
tin.origin: Jos Plateau & North-Central Tin Belt, Nigeria
tin.description: High-gravity alluvial and hard-rock cassiterite concentrate extracted from Nigeria historic Jos Plateau mineral belt, washed and electromagnetically separated to meet international smelter purity standards.
tin.complianceNote: Delivered with XRF/wet-chemistry tin assay and export radiation clearance documentation upon container stuffing.
packagingOptions: 50 kg Double-Woven Polypropylene Sacks (20 MT / 20ft FCL)
applications: Primary tin smelting and lead-free electronics solder manufacturing
Tinplate food-grade steel coating and chemical stabilizers
Bronze, babbitt bearing, and specialty industrial alloys

coltan.name: Columbite & Tantalite (Coltan)
coltan.subtitle: High Ta₂O₅ / Nb₂O₅ Ratio Concentrates
coltan.moq: 1 × 20ft Container (20 MT) / Air Lot on Review
coltan.description: High-density columbite-tantalite concentrates processed for electronics capacitor manufacturing, superalloys, and aerospace metallurgy, with rigorous radiation screening and elemental XRF/ICP assays.

packagingOptions: 50 kg Lined Steel Drums / Double PP Sacks
applications: Tantalum electrolytic capacitors for semiconductors and 5G hardware
Nickel-niobium superalloys for jet turbines and aerospace structures
High-strength micro-alloyed structural steel production

lead-zinc.name: Lead & Zinc Ore
lead-zinc.subtitle: Galena & Sphalerite Sulfide Concentrates
lead-zinc.description: High-grade galena (lead sulfide) and sphalerite (zinc sulfide) ores sourced from Nigeria Benue Trough belt, separated for smelting, galvanizing steel mills, and industrial battery fabrication.
lead-zinc.complianceNote: Sorted separately by lead or zinc dominance upon request, with full weighbridge and pre-shipment assay certificates.
applications: Industrial lead-acid storage batteries and radiation shielding
Hot-dip zinc galvanizing for structural steel protection
Die-casting alloys, brass metallurgy, and zinc oxide chemicals

iron.name: Iron Ore
iron.subtitle: Hematite & Magnetite
iron.origin: Kogi & Niger Iron Ore Belt, Nigeria
iron.description: Dense hematite and magnetite iron ore calibrated into blast-furnace lump or sinter fines, delivering consistent Fe grades and low gangue for domestic foundries, cement kilns, and export steelmaking.

packagingOptions: 1,000 kg / 1,500 kg Jumbo FIBC Export Bags
Bulk Containerized or Breakbulk Port Staging
applications: Integrated steelmaking, direct reduction (DRI), and rolling mills
Portland cement clinker iron-corrective additive
Heavy aggregate ballast and high-density concrete weighting

limestone.name: Limestone & Marble Aggregates
limestone.subtitle: High-Calcium Carbonate Stone

Calcium carbonate industrial filler (paint, PVC, paper, agriculture)
Architectural marble cladding, flooring, and civil infrastructure stone

stages.title: Specification & Scope Alignment
stages.detail: Buyers submit target tonnage, chemical grade thresholds, delivery destination, and Incoterms through our Procurement Desk or engineering brief.

stages.title: Independent Lab Assay & Title Check
stages.detail: Lot samples dey pulled for accredited lab assay, moisture verification, and mineral origin documentation before formal commitment.

stages.title: Processing, Calibration & Packaging
stages.detail: Ores dey crushed, washed, or bagged into serialized 1MT FIBC jumbo bags, 50kg PP sacks, security drums, or calibrated tipper loads.

stages.title: Mine-to-Site & Port Export Dispatch
stages.detail: Coordinated haulage dey deliver direct to project sites across Nigeria or staged export terminals for Lagos (Apapa/Tin Can) and Port Harcourt.
